His ability to tell stories, share history, and convey the unique atmosphere and spirit of Barcelona made the tour truly special. We learned so much and enjoyed every minute. Highly recommended!

title: Emma old town tour! Amazing
text:
We went on a tour of old town Barcelona with a wonderful young lady named Emma. She was so knowledgeable, funny and likable. You can tell she is passionate about what she does and we loved getting to know her. Couldn’t recommend doing a tour with her more. Emma next time we are in town we hope to see you! Thank you so very much.
-John, Janet and Sammy McDonald
author: JohnM_M

title: Great Barcelona introduction
text: Emma gave good information to coordinate our meet up. She was very approachable, made us comfortable right away. The tour itself was organized and informative without being rigid. A perfect introduction to Barcelona and a great way to power through jet lag on our first day.
author: Elizabeth_F

title: A walk-through time in the Gothic quarter
text: Our tour guide Emma well seem very young was a wealth of information concerning this beautiful part of Barcelona. She had very in-depth knowledge about specific areas, architecture, and development periods. We enjoyed her company as we stroll through the streets of the Gothic Quarter in Barcelona.
author: Patrick_B

title: Excellent Guide and Tour!
text: Emma provided us with a terrific tour of the Gothic Quarter! She was warm, knowledgeable, and fun to be with! She was easy to understand as she brought the different aspects of the Gothic Quarter to life. In addition, she communicated well leading up to the tour. We highly recommend Emma and her Gothic Quarter tour!!!
author: Jenny_L

title: Enjoyable Walking Tour
text: We enjoyed this short walking tour and Emma was a lovely guide.  We had just flown in on over night flight from Canada and had to wait for our hotel room so this was just the perfect amount of time and information for us about the old town.
author: Kim_T
